text:
...!
Mya-mya~!
So it's all right...
This is my problem,
and mine alone...!
...!
Bii-bii~!
Please...
Leave me alone...
...!
Quiupy~!
▲...
▲...
▲...
▲...
▲...
That didn't go well, did it?
Scarrel...
Listen, Teacher.
Let me tell you something.
A finely polished mirror
reflects things clearly,
but...
what it reflects
won't necessarily
look beautiful.
Sometimes it only
makes the parts we don't want
to see stand out all the more.
It's not the mirror's fault, though.
...
In the end,
▲ and I
never got to talk after that.
How on earth
did things turn out
like this?
In the end,
▲ and I
never talked after that...
In the end,
▲ and I
never talked after that...
How did things
end up this way?
...
Is something wrong?
Oh, no.
I was just
spacing out a little.
Oh, I'm sorry.
I was lost
in thought.
As long as that's all.
Anyway, right now
I need to focus on the investigation.
Right...!
When you said investigation,
I thought there'd be
a fair number of people coming.
Only two?
That's a bit of a surprise.
THIS IS ENOUGH.
If we bring too many,
we may only
provoke them into fighting.
If our aim had been to defeat them
from the outset, we'd have
brought an appropriate force.
That's true.
It's not smart
to go tramping around
in a big group.
Do not worry.
If it comes to battle,
I will end it all myself.
You need only
accompany us
as impartial witnesses.
Oh, my?
